name: Multi-asset contract COLA override per asset (keying bug)
expected: 4 assets on one Activated contract (override 4%) each apply their own Contract Override -> 4 UnitPrices uplifted 4%, COLA_Source='Contract Override' on all 4.
actual: queryAssetContracts returned only 1 row (last asset RVDQ): RVDQ=4% Contract Override (UnitPrice 2102.10 correct); RVDN/RVDO/RVDP collapsed to CMDT default 7.85% (UnitPrice 6539.75 vs correct 6306.30, +233.45 each), COLA_Source mislabeled 'CMDT Lookup'.
evidence: Contract 00003473 https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Contract/800WC00000PCpoMYAT/view ; Asset RVDN https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Asset/02iWC000007RVDNYA4/view ; live Apex probe F05_PROBE rowsReturned=1, MISSING={RVDN,RVDO,RVDP}
defectStep: AssetContractQueryHelper.buildResults (COLA prehook feeding V21 'COLA Uplift on Renewal' steps 26-28)
proposedFix: In AssetContractQueryHelper.buildResults, contractToAssetMap is Map<Id,Id> keyed by ContractId (last-write-wins) -> 4 ACRs on 1 contract collapse to 1 wrapper. Iterate ACR rows joined to the activated-contract map and emit one AssetContractData per ACR/asset so every asset on a shared contract gets the override. NOT applied (validation only).
notes: Bug reproduced deterministically on live data: 1 Activated multi-asset contract (800WC00000PCpoMYAT/00003473, COLA_Override_Percent__c=4, 4 ACRs, Solution Category 'Doc Management' CMDT default 7.85%). Defect is in the Apex prehook layer upstream of V21; V21 COLA gate fires on already-wrong COLA_Uplift_Percent. Field is COLA_Override_Percent__c (catalog loosely names it Contract_COLA_Override_Percent__c).
